title: Origin story: Zephyrion
description: Zephyrion was the youngest windrider of the sky-clans, who rode the high currents on glider-wings of canvas and bone. When the sky-clans fell to the storm-kings, he alone kept the wind-roads, carrying messages between the free cities on currents no storm-king could follow. He is the last, and he still flies.

title: Ability profile: Zephyrion
description: Ranked abilities: Wind-reading — rank 100/100; Glider flight — rank 99/100; Courage — rank 96/100; Navigation — rank 95/100; Endurance — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Zephyrion
description: Powers: The wind-roads obey his wings; He reads storms like letters; The high currents carry him past all pursuit.

title: Stamina feats: Zephyrion
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Flew three days through the Great Storm; Rides the sky-roads year after year.

title: Crossover notes: Zephyrion
description: Zephyrion crosses naturally with: winds, sky-roads, the high currents.

title: Design notes: Zephyrion
description: The sky as sanctuary; the last rider of the wind-roads.
